query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `enterprise_plans` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `emailLimit` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 200,
  `smsPerDay` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,
  `maxSeats` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
  `maxManualPerDay` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,
  `monthlyPrice` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `annualPrice` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `allowOutlook` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `allowGmail` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `customFeatures` text,
  `notes` text,
  `createdBy` int NOT NULL,
  `isActive` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `enterprise_plans_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
